summary: A mostly clean Thai law firm site with only two subtle defects. Tests restraint: the agent must not report problems that are not there.

expected_facts.fact: The phone number is inconsistent: the footer and the LegalService markup say 02-000-1100, while the contact page body and its meta description say 02-000-1199.
The two practice-area titles (family law and business law) are far too long, well over 60 characters each, and will be truncated in results.
robots.txt allows every crawler, including GPTBot, ClaudeBot and PerplexityBot, and declares sitemap.xml, which lists 5 URLs that all return 200.
llms.txt is present and well formed.
The home page has LegalService structured data with a full address and telephone.
Every page has one H1, a meta description and a self-referencing canonical, and the contact form fields have proper labels. None of these should be reported as defects.
